title: The M5 Motorway (Junctions 1 to 3) (60 Miles Per Hour Speed Limit) Regulations 2022 (Revocation) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations revoke the 60 miles per hour speed limit on the M5 motorway between junctions 1 and 3 and on slip roads at junctions 1 and 2. In consequence, the national motorway speed limit will apply upon the coming into force of these Regulations.

title: The Housing Benefit (Earned Income Disregards) (Amendment) (No. 2) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Housing Benefit (Earned Income Disregards) (Amendment) Regulations 2026 (S.I. 2026/753) (“the Earned Income Disregards Regulations”) to clarify and extend the application of the earnings disregards introduced by those regulations to claimants of housing benefit.

title: Act of Sederunt (Summary Cause Rules 2002 Amendment) (Domestic Abuse (Protection) (Scotland) Act 2021) 2026
summary: This Act of Sederunt amends the Summary Cause Rules 2002 in consequence of the provisions of section 22 of the Domestic Abuse (Protection) (Scotland) Act 2021.

summary: This Act of Sederunt amends the Act of Sederunt (Fees of Messengers-at-Arms and Sheriff Officers) 2026 to correct drafting errors in that instrument.

title: The Employment Rights Act 2025 (Commencement No. 5 and Transitional Provisions) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary:

section 152 of, and 
Schedule 12 to, the

summary: The United Kingdom is a signatory to the Paris Memorandum of Understanding on Port State Control which provides an international regime for the enforcement of standards for ship safety, pollution prevention and shipboard living and working conditions.

title: The Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (Information Provision and Amounts) (Amendment) Regulations 2026
summary: These Regulations amend the Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (General) and Road Traffic (NHS Charges) (Amendment) Regulations 2006 (S.I. 2006/3388) (“the 2006 Regulations”) and the Personal Injuries (NHS Charges) (Amounts) Regulations 2015 (S.I. 2015/295) (“the 2015 Regulations”). The 2006 and 2015 Regulations form part of the legislative framework of the injury cost recovery scheme under Part 3 of the Health and Social Care (Community Health and Standards) Act 2003 (c. 43).
